pkgmetadata.longdescription: tie is a client for a triple-store (tie-daemon) plus a content-addressed blob store (tie-filehost). The CLI uploads and downloads files, tags them, imports directory trees, and mounts collections as a FUSE filesystem. This package installs the tie CLI along with the tie-daemon and tie-filehost servers and their service files.

use.flag: Build support for mounting collections as a FUSE filesystem (the sys-fs/fuse backed "tie mount" command).
